paragraphs: Durham School Services runs contracted student transportation for school districts across the country. The company describes itself as part of a network that carries more than a million students every day.

A district that contracts with Durham hands over routing, fleet, staffing and maintenance. Beyond daily routes, the company offers specialized service designed around student-specific needs and IEP requirements. It also covers field trips, athletics and special events. Support can extend to driver recruiting, screening and training. Fleet procurement, maintenance and lifecycle planning can sit with the company as well.

Durham has worked with school districts since 1917. It began as a three-bus operation in California's San Gabriel Valley, with early expertise in transporting students with specialized needs. Local operating teams are backed by the broader Summit School Services network for safety, recruiting, maintenance and technology.

quote.text: Getting students to school safely, on time and ready to learn
